# Anabhi Dev

> Personal developer brand based in Bali, Indonesia. Building websites, automation systems, and AI-powered products for hospitality operations and lifestyle sectors.

## Key Platforms & Ecosystem

- [Anabhi Dev Roadmap](https://roadmap.anabhidev.com/): Master visual portfolio roadmap tracking 85 projects across Personal (51), Office (31), and Shared platforms (3). Features live status, technology stack filtering, and system catalog.
- [Engineering Lab](https://labs.anabhidev.com/): Living engineering workshop behind anabhidev.com — project registry, development timeline, technical insights, and experiment logs.
- [BaliEats AI](https://anabhidev.com/BaliEats-AI/): AI-powered Bali culinary assistant. Traditional Balinese food, street food, seafood, vegetarian options, nutritional analysis of food photos, Bali food calendar by ceremony, and restaurant recommendations by area.
- [Career Suite](https://anabhidev.com/Career-Suite/): Comprehensive suite of 5 tools for job seekers and recruiters (CV Analyzer, CV Screener, Salary benchmark, Career path, Interview prep).
- [Child Smart Play](https://anabhidev.com/Child-Smart-Play/): Interactive educational games for children covering mathematics, language, and logic.

## About

- [Anabhi Dev](https://anabhidev.com): Developer profile and portfolio by I Gede Agus Wibawa, based in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia. 15 years of hospitality IT experience building lightweight, reliable web solutions, Google Apps Script automation, Gemini API integrations, and Cloudflare Pages deployments.
